title: 3rd Infantry Division Marne Week 2022 Tug of War B-Roll
description: Soldiers assigned to 3rd Infantry Division compete during the Marne Week 2022 tug of war event, Nov. 28. Marne Week is an annual event that promotes esprit de corps and celebrates 3ID history. Each day of Marne Week, there were multiple competitions happening simultaneously around the installation, ranging from boxing to dodgeball.
